outcome: differentiation of intra-abdominal abscesses from hematomas
cohort: Patients with intra-abdominal abscesses or hematomas who underwent shear wave elastography prior to ultrasound-guided drainage in an interventional radiology clinic between 2021 and 2022.
finding: The mean shear wave velocity of hematomas was significantly higher than that of abscesses, indicating its utility in differentiating between these two conditions.
